name: french-civics-infrastructure
description: AWS CDK infrastructure for French Civics Test App

scripts.package-lambda: cd ../src && zip -r /tmp/lambda-code.zip . -x '*.pyc' -x '__pycache__/*' -x '*/__pycache__/*' -x '*/*/__pycache__/*' && echo '✅ Lambda code packaged to /tmp/lambda-code.zip'
scripts.deploy-lambda: npm run package-lambda && for func in french-civics-get-user-profile french-civics-get-user-stats french-civics-get-user-history french-civics-list-topics french-civics-get-topic french-civics-get-next-question french-civics-submit-answer french-civics-get-question; do echo "Updating $func..." && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name $func --zip-file fileb:///tmp/lambda-code.zip --query 'FunctionName' --output text; done && echo '✅ All Lambda functions deployed'
scripts.deploy-lambda-quick: for func in french-civics-get-user-profile french-civics-get-user-stats french-civics-get-user-history french-civics-list-topics french-civics-get-topic french-civics-get-next-question french-civics-submit-answer french-civics-get-question; do echo "Updating $func..." && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name $func --zip-file fileb:///tmp/lambda-code.zip --query 'FunctionName' --output text; done && echo '✅ All Lambda functions deployed'

author: Emily Jones
